items.title: 68436_Alberta Hunter oral history interview
items.q: So when the girl came it was Ellen Winston, my mother's friend's daughter. And she let me stay there.

ctx.x: And when I got to the building -- you know, like when you get off the streetcar, well, I was facing the building. So I walked upstairs in this building. There was a lady washing. Her name was Miss Love. So I said, "Lady, do you know a girl around here by the name of Ellen Winston?" She said, "No, I don't, child. What you doing here, where are you from?" And I said, "Well, I'm looking for Ellen Winston." She said, "Well, I'm asking you where you're from." So I said, "I'm from Memphis." She said, "Memphis?" I said,…
So when the girl came it was Ellen Winston, my mother's friend's daughter. And she let me stay there.
So how'd you know where to go?
